messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: Elevated 5xx error rate detected on api-gateway-us-east-1. Group: gateway-edge. Alert: gateway_502_spike_1766123456. Threshold: 5xx > 8% for 2m.
oncall-sre: I'm on-call, acked. joining now.
alex: seeing same on dashboards -> https://dashboards.internal/redwood/api-gateway?region=us-east-1 (spike started ~T-3m).
maria: @oncall-sre can you confirm which tier? edge or internal?
oncall-sre: edge tier (frontend proxies). tailing logs now.
jamal: I can pull flow logs + envoy metrics. Running `gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND protoPayload.status>=500" --limit 50` now.
caroline: support channel reporting higher latencies & 502s. Ivy, any customer mentions?
support-ivy: a handful of enterprise customers flagged increased errors for the last ~10m, some timeouts in region us-east. Logged a support ticket for ACME corp (INC-8472).
oncall-sre: grabbing proxy logs. Quick look: lots of `upstream reset` and `502 Bad Gateway` with upstream hostpool exhaustion markers.
ops-bot: Note: recent canary deploy completed 12m ago for `edge-proxy-v6`. Rollout status: 40% -> 100% (auto).
alex: timeline looks like deploy finished then errors rose. correlation high.
maria: can we rollback the canary or pin to previous image?
oncall-sre: I'm going to pause the rollout and roll back canary group. Executing: `orchctl rollout pause edge-proxy && orchctl rollout undo edge-proxy --to-revision=rev-23`
(about 60s pass)
oncall-sre: rollback command issued. Monitoring metrics.
jamal: pulling recent envoy stats for a bad pod:
```
pod=edge-proxy-6f9b8    cluster: upstream-api   5xx: 12.3%   conn: 502 resets: 84
pod=edge-proxy-6f9b7    cluster: upstream-api   5xx: 11.8%   conn: 502 resets: 79
```
caroline: any signs of a config change separate from image? e.g., routing table, timeouts?
oncall-sre: no config rollouts in last 24h per config-audit. Canary image includes libssl bump — could be quirk with keepalive settings.
alex: temp mitigation: can we enable circuit-breaker fallback to cached backend? `gatewayctl set-fallback cache=true`
oncall-sre: enabling fallback routing to cache and increasing connection pool for upstreams. `gatewayctl update upstreams --pool=200`
(30s)
oncall-sre: fallback enabled. 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 4% in the last 90s.
support-ivy: Customer impact estimate: 120k requests affected, ~0.6% of global traffic, some errors in dashboards and 3 support escalations so far.
maria: great, keep fallback until rollback fully propagated. Also we should throttle non-critical routes to reduce load. `ratelimitctl set route /public/docs 50rps`
oncall-sre: throttling non-prod and public doc routes.
jamal: logs show a subset of upstreams still failing due to connection resets. I'm restarting 2 pods with highest reset counts. `k restart pod edge-proxy-6f9b8`
oncall-sre: restarts done. Metrics now: 5xx ~2.1%. latency p95 improving.
caroline: do we need to open a customer-facing incident? Support recommended an incident banner for impacted customers.
support-ivy: yes, initial message drafted: "We are investigating elevated 502/504 errors in us-east; mitigation in place; updates every 30m." Happy to post after you confirm messaging.
oncall-sre: post the banner. Add guidance to use regional endpoint fallback (us-west) if available.
ops-bot: Reminder: notify Dedicated customers per SLA after 30m of degraded service.
alex: tagging product and infra to look into the `libssl` bump and why it interacts with keepalive. @maria can you lead root cause?
maria: will take lead. I'll collect binary diffs and test harness runs against keepalive load.
jamal: saving logs & sample traces to /tmp/incidents/1766123456-logs.tar.gz and uploading to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/1766123456.tar.gz
caroline: next steps: 1) keep fallback for 45m, 2) fully rollback if 5xx > 5% persist for 5m, 3) post banner and update support tickets, 4) create post-incident blameless RCA.
oncall-sre: agreed. I'm keeping the channel open for 45m and will update every 10m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
(10m later)
oncall-sre: Update T+10m: rollback completed and stable. 5xx now ~0.8% and trending down. Fallback will remain for 30m then we plan to remove if stable.
support-ivy: Banner posted and customers notified. ACME corp updated.
maria: I've queued local repro tests for the canary image; initial hypothesis is keepalive handling regressions.
jamal: logs preserved and attached to the ticket.
caroline: filing incident ticket and scheduling RCA meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT. Please add any follow-ups to INC-8472.
oncall-sre: closing active mitigation. leaving notes and runbooks updated. If we see reoccurrence re-open this thread.
ops-bot: Incident closed for paging purposes. ESCALATION: none outstanding.
alex: thanks everyone for fast responses. good job on the rollback + fallback.
support-ivy: will follow up on customer notes and collect full impact for billing and SLA audit.
(medium-term) maria: will test with load harness then propose fix or revert permanently.
noncall-sre: thread will remain archived under incident-1766123456.
